</details>

Use of `fs.readSync`, `writeFileSync`, and direct code patching via string replacement are standard in build tooling and not inherently malicious.

The script reads local files (asar, icns) provided as arguments, writes to a specified output directory, and makes targeted edits to application logic (e.g., short-circuiting auto-updater on Linux). These are expected behaviors for a preparatory build script in a desktop application packaging workflow. No obfuscation, suspicious commands, or unauthorized system access is present.
